svg.text: Two independent attacks on the same RTL. Properties are written once, in a subset both engines accept.
What open source does NOT give you - plan around these
- No CDC tool of production quality. Mitigated by design: the synchronous NHI leaves only two crossings (Figure 4).
- No UVM. cocotb + pyuvm covers the structure; PyVSC covers randomization and coverage.
- Verilator is 2-state, so reset and X-propagation bugs can hide. Icarus runs the reset suite as a gate.
- No gate-level SDF simulation at speed. Plan for vendor tools at signoff, or lean on eqy equivalence.
